Bindhyabasini Temple.name: Bindhyabasini Temple
Bindhyabasini Temple.description: Bindhyabasini Temple is one of the oldest temples in Pokhara, dedicated to Goddess Bhagawati (Durga). Located on a hillock, it offers views of the Annapurna range.

Lumbini.name: Lumbini
Lumbini.description: Lumbini is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and the sacred birthplace of Lord Gautama Buddha, featuring the Maya Devi Temple and Ashoka Pillar.

Patan Durbar Square.name: Patan Durbar Square
Patan Durbar Square.description: Patan Durbar Square is a UNESCO World Heritage site known for its marvelous Malla-era architecture, metal statues, Krishna Mandir, and fine arts.
